android.desc:
AirLynk is a file transfer app for sharing photos, videos, music, documents, apps (APK) and whole folders between phones. No file size limit, no account and no cloud upload.

📡 TWO WAYS TO SEND

NEARBY: share files without internet
For phones in the same room. AirLynk connects the two phones directly over Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, so it works offline and uses no mobile data.

ANYWHERE: send files to any distance
For someone in another city or country. Share a QR code or a link; when they open it, the files go from your phone to theirs, end-to-end encrypted. Nothing is uploaded to a cloud drive and your files are not stored on any server.

🔗 PAIRED DEVICES
Pair your own phones, or a family member's phone, once with a link. After that, pick the files, choose the device and the transfer starts, with no scanning again, even when you're far apart.

✨ FEATURES
• Send large files: GB-sized videos, no size limit
• All file types: photos, videos, audio, documents, APKs, archives and folders
• Built-in file and media browser with thumbnails
• QR code and link sharing
• Transfers keep running in the background
• No account or sign-up
• Dark and light theme

🔒 PRIVACY
Your files go from phone to phone. When the two phones can't reach each other directly, the encrypted data passes through a relay server that can't read it and doesn't keep it.
We use Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and short connection reports to fix crashes and connection problems; they never contain your files. Ads from Google AdMob keep AirLynk free.

💡 HOW IT WORKS

Nearby:
1. Open AirLynk on both phones
2. One taps Receive, the other taps Send
3. Pick files, choose the nearby phone and the transfer starts

Anywhere:
1. Pick files → Send → Anywhere
2. Share the QR code or link
3. The other person scans the code or opens the link, and the files arrive

Paired devices:
1. Paired Devices → Add Device, then share the link
2. Next time: pick files → choose the device → done

📁 SUPPORTED FILES
Photos (JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, BMP, HEIC), videos (MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WEBM), audio (MP3, AAC, FLAC, WAV, OGG), documents (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT), apps (APK), archives (ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR) and any other file type.

AirLynk: file transfer and file sharing, nearby or anywhere.
